title: REQ · Guard reports tracked dependency and test-cache paths from git ls-files output
summary: A pure helper and parser report tracked node_modules and .vite paths
description: Context: trackedNodeModulesPaths only matches a node_modules segment and nothing reads real git output. Desired: parse NUL-separated git ls-files output and flag node_modules or .vite segments. Why: the guard needs real tracked file lists.
acceptance_criteria: Given paths including node_modules/a.js and src/.vite/x.json, when filtered, then both are returned and src/a.ts is not
Given git ls-files -z output, when parsed, then empty entries are dropped and paths split on NUL
technical_constraints: Pure functions; git runner injected via GitRunner type
